title: New Vegas PipBoy
description: A simple mod that adds the pipboy from fallout new vegas to minecraft
body:
# PipBoy 

Small mod that add a new item inspired in the PipBoy MK3000 from fallout new vegas

## Features

- Main Screen with stats about the player (health, hunger, xp level)
- A small inventory that is drop upon death
- Time of the day (works as a better clock)
- With implementation of [LambDynamicLights](https://modrinth.com/mod/lambdynamiclights) to toggle the pipboy dynamicLight (without the mod the buttons doesn't work)

## Credits 

Original Idea, 3d model and gui [JxstCris_](https://modrinth.com/user/JxstCris_)
